reviews.title: Friendly airline to fly with
reviews.text: It was Boeing 737 with 3-3 configuration. The flight time was 3.5 hours. The flight had inflight entertainment, good food (Two options one Mongolian and the other was Western. Pillow and blankets were not available may be because it was short haul flight.
reviews.author: Suddhasattwa M

reviews.title: Terrible service and communication
reviews.text: I had one back bag and cabin luggage with me but had to pay 80 euros at the last minute for my 8kg cabin luggage just before boarding my plane. I feel totally scammed!!!
reviews.author: Uugii M

reviews.title: Lack of management
reviews.text: Is a terrible airline, seems all true in comments. I want to buy for UB from FRankfurt a flight compare with Turkish the price and MIAT don't respond to emails, is no customer service support and not even able to buy online ticket. I speak german and I've tried to call Berlin office and nobody never replies. Emails from Offcial browser MIAT comes back as wrong adresses. I travel a lot, but never heard such nonsense. ALL EU are half billion citizen and you're not even able to buy online tickets. Food in pics is terrible and seems no entertainemnt on board. I have conversation with MIAT on meseengear.
reviews.author: Cosmin Pitesteanu

reviews.title: Flight delayed
reviews.text: I had a delay of 7.5 hours, i only got a 20 dollar voucher for food. I want all the money back from the flight or i will undergo actions. Shame yourself
reviews.author: Badyo

reviews.title: Short vacation
reviews.text: The worst airline in the world. Charged for carry on bag and sent through check in. When I got to my final destination there is no baggage. Can you believe when someone is on vacation and they don’t even have their personal belongings. That sucks…..never recommend this flight to anyone..period…
reviews.author: namgyel w

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: I know if difficult time for everyone but that not justify not service in a 10 h flight just water and a dry /hard croissant, no entertainment and the space between rows are to small that I barely fit ( I am 5’7) The ground service is terrible on both way. I travel a lot and never been in a airline with such a bad service
reviews.author: Soraida M

reviews.title: The best choice to fly to Ulaanbaatar from Hong Kong
reviews.text: It was just like any other flight to me. It kinds of only way, or very limited choice to fly to Ulaanbaatar, so of course it was a bit more expensive, I guessed. My flight was normal as any others.
reviews.author: Hai N

reviews.title: First time and amazing
reviews.text: First time in Business Class with this airline and i was absolutely impressed with the service and quality of the food presented. Short flight of just over 2 hours but well worth the experience. I have also travelled economy with this airline and while it doesn't match BC, it still is better than most other short haul lines. Recommended when you are going to Mongolia. Mongolia in itself is well worth a look at.
reviews.author: Russell T

reviews.title: Hit or Miss with Miat Mongolia
reviews.text: I originally flew to Mongolia on Aeroflot, then transferred in Moscow to Miat Mongolia. That trip was a miss. They changed the gate to the furthest one back of the airport. I was so worried about missing my connection. But it turned out that the flight was late, I ended up waiting to board for an hour, which meant the people waiting to pick me up waited for over an hour for me. My luggage, (along with half the passengers of that flight) did not make it. I did receive my luggage the next day. When the guy in front of me put his seat back, he was literally in my lap. I couldn't open my tray table or shift in my seat. So 90 days later I was sent to South Korea. I call it a "visa run". If you leave Mongolia for a day and return, your 90 days are reset, and you get another 90 days. This is for Americans, I don't know about visa restrictions for other countries. That flight was a hit. The plane left pretty much ontime, flight was uneventful, arrived safely and was more comfortable than my first experience. The food was alright as far as airplane food goes. The only problem I had was that as it was a small airline it shared space with two other airlines at the airport. I couldn't check in until right before the flight. Which means as my flight was late, all the cool shops were closed by time I got to the gate side. I also had to ask someone since I didn't see the airlines in the check-in and was confused. When I did check-in it was fine and the flight was on time. I had meal service even though it was 1am. Same food as before so I had the other choice. Just a note, Mongolian food is a bit bland, they provide salt but no pepper. I arrived on time no problems. It is a fine airlines I just think it depends where you are flying to or from. Just be prepared, they could be very late.
reviews.author: Global768312

reviews.title: Ok, mediocre
reviews.text: Check-in and baggage-drop was ok and flight was on time. The service in business class was a bit disappointing as the food equaled the food which is served in economy class of better airline (e.g. Singapore or Emirates). Otherwise, cabin crew was very friendly. No individual TV screens.
reviews.author: Pinga123

reviews.title: Things to improve!
reviews.text: Not one of MIAT's better flights. The flight got off to a surprisingly good start, leaving a full three minutes ahead of the scheduled departure time! But, the 767-300ER plane was poorly maintained, with the seat pocket torn and falling away from the seat in front of me and the volume control for in-flight entertainment broken. No choice of meal provided (and what was provided wasn't anything to write home about). Flight crew was OK.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Smooth flight from Seoul!
reviews.text: Left a little late, but flight itself was smooth and comfortable. Plane (767-300ER) was clean and comfortable.
reviews.author: Raintree_Thailand

reviews.title: Lots of leg room
reviews.text: The plane had ashtrays. This instantly fired off alarm bells for its age!!! The seats were shabby and the whole plane looked like it needed to retire! The check in process at UB was substandard! multiple lines and lots of stress!
reviews.author: star2450

reviews.title: Fuss free-Frills free
reviews.text: With the poor reviews I read online before my trip, I was pretty nervous about the flight. Having done it, it is my opinion that the reviews given were somewhat harsh. Though not a fancy ride, it was not terrible. Meals were acceptable and journey smooth. The major drawbacks were the luggage weight limit of 23kg and lack of entertainment onboard.
reviews.author: Julie N

reviews.title: Good service but no entry documents
reviews.text: I was surprised and the comfort and efficiency of the airline. Not all developing countries have a good infrastructure, but Miat seems to, at least on the international flights. Attendants were friendly and spoke English and/or Korean. The economy seats were roomy and comfortable. There was a free movie and dinner on a three hour flight. The food was airline food; I have had worse. My only complaint is that they have no entry documents out. I am used to airlines doing this when it is required. When I received no documents my brain went into Europe mode and I thought there were none needed. Entry forms and customer form were available at passport control, but it was a mad scramble with the other passengers.
reviews.author: Heidi D

reviews.title: Good window seat
reviews.text: Lucky to have a seat near the front of economy section which provided a clear view once clear of the HK clouds. It was a fantastic sigt to fly across northern China and then for 2 hours or more across the Gobi desert towards UB as the locals call Ulaanbaatar. It was a clear sky day and we had excellent views all the way for about 4 hours. See the Gobi for the first time is a sight like no other, the dry and dusty flat lands with trails across the desert, maybe unchanged since the original silk road.
reviews.author: Murray L

reviews.title: Comfortable and on time
reviews.text: Well organised service in a comfortable modern 737 that left on time and arrived early. Slightly officious crew and bumpy landing but all good!
reviews.author: OnwardTraveller

reviews.title: Horror trip
reviews.text: We have been stuck in the Frankfurt airport for more than 20 hours. Incompetence of the airline is beyond reason. Since Saturday midday we have been delayed numerous times with no clear explanation.... latest announcement delayed flight by 4 h due to the lack of food on the plane..... this airline is simply ridiculous!!! Very likely we will spend another day at the Frankfurt airport .... no view on actual departure
reviews.author: Piotr K

reviews.title: Even better flight, service and food
reviews.text: This was a larger plane than our first flight so had the additional benefit of seatback screens and slightly better legroom. Food was better as well. Service was also good. This was a better timed flight as often the flights to HKG leave very early in the morning except, apparently, on a Monday.
reviews.author: Grumpybrother

reviews.title: Surprisingly good
reviews.text: Small plane, good service and the food was acceptable. This is a 4 hour flight, but the plane we were on was one of those small ones so the entertainment was the drop down screens with no choice of what to watch. Luckily we were prepared so I had brought reading matter. Because we had been prewarned about the food we made sure that we had extra snacks with us which were very welcome.
reviews.author: Grumpybrother

reviews.title: Great food and staff
reviews.text: Flew with Mongolian airlines to and from HK. The first flight ended up being delayed by 7 hours and it was hard to get ongoing info about this - due to high winds and storms. Miat do not provide food/accommodation for such events. However flight, food and service good. Aircraft a little down at heel.
reviews.author: tes108

reviews.title: Everything was just great.
reviews.text: Easy, hasslefree checkin. I was not allowed to pick a seat, but the airline gave med a good one. Modern aircraft, nice service. It is amazing that a small (population wise) nation can have such a great airline. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Vlad W

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: This was my first time flying with Miat - the aircraft was new, seats were reasonably spaced and the flight was on time. The cabin service was also good - I would definitely fly with them again.
reviews.author: Margaret W

reviews.title: Fair price, good service
reviews.text: It was my second flight with MIAT after the flight to Ulaanbaatar two weeks earlier. Only five passengers in business class and plenty of space there. The airplane has left ULN on time and arrived to TXL on time. The seats are comfortable; not fully flat (horizontal) but as good as in other airplanes of the same standard. Quality of food was good; the dishes could be better (some plastic ... but not really woth to claim about). The stewardesses are very kind and they have frequently asked me if I would desire anything. In general: Perfect!
reviews.author: Roland Martini

reviews.title: New meaning to cattle class
reviews.text: Forget this mob if over 6ft, seats are jammed in with no leg room. Departure from Ulaanbaatar was a disorganized scrum. Service on the plane was so so with staff not looking like they were all that enthused . The food was at best passable, a huge wad of mashed potato with a few bits of meat and sad beans. Probably not the best experience.
reviews.author: SEAchange2018

reviews.title: Friendly and  very helpful cabin crew
reviews.text: Normally there are 2 flights from Incheon to Ulaanbator daily. I chose to reach Ulaanbator earlier i.e. by 5pm local time so I chose MIAT (alternatively - Korean Air, to reach Ulaanbator by 9.55pm) Overall experience of the 4 hour flight was fine despite uncontrollable weather conditions ( very bright sun but cloudy outside and still had turbulence every hour). I sat next to 3x young mothers with toddlers yesterday and saw how the young male flight attendant(s) at Row 9DEF being genuinely attentive so that the mothers can managed their toddlers and not cry or wail the entire flight. Bringing kids kit, bringing hot food for both mother and kid, giving hot water every hour or so, talking to the toddlers, etc. Most airlines will warn you about turbulence after the plane started shaking, but Miat was very quick in announcing ahead so that everyone is prepared. Perhaps the pilots really know every spot of the journey as they fly the same route every day. Landing appears difficult but once it touched down, everything was just fine and well! Hot food is not bad and quite fresh. Despite the plane being not new and not equipped with the latest entertainment, other good factors did make up for it.
reviews.author: CeeWiAr

reviews.title: Poor Quality Food
reviews.text: I regularly fly between Hong Kong and Ulaanbaatar. There are two types of plane used by MIAT on this route. One type has a drop down screen every few rows, one type has a small screen on the back of the seat. Bring a tablet or book in case you get the plane with the drop down screen. The quality of the food on this flight is always poor. I eat at the Hong Kong airport before the flight.
reviews.author: Mike P

reviews.title: Typical average airline
reviews.text: MIAT is the only international airline in Mongolia, it is state owned company. The service is good for small airlines.
reviews.author: Aanjaa M

reviews.title: They have the best service
reviews.text: I have flied with so many airlines companies. I think they are the best. The staff is very friendly, speak all good in english, food was delicious and the seat was very comfortable. Also the pilot was the best.. congratulations to all.. actually I was not expecting that
reviews.author: Simone

reviews.title: Specialist of flying in Mongolian sky
reviews.text: The flight was on time and very sufficient to travel to Mongolia. Environment in the cabin was quite fair and provided reasonable meal service. Only concern 737-800 aircraft was bit old and leg space was limited like LCC. The airline is under replacing those to new ones, 737-MAX8, which are now on the ground. Anyway It was enough goodness to fly on such short flight and environment on Chinese routes, where we sometimes experience some difficulties.
reviews.author: momiji2018

reviews.title: Airline okay - travellers not
reviews.text: Flew with MIAT recently. All good. On time. Service good but Got pickpocketed while waiting to deplane. Lost a large amount of cash and my credit card. Be careful with people using this airline, there are criminals about.
reviews.author: Graham B

reviews.title: Very bad service re: vegan food
reviews.text: When I booked my recent return flights from Beijing to Ulaanbaatar, I requested a vegan meal, but didn’t get a reply. I made sure on the return flight to Beijing that I would request this and got confirmation via email. I was told it would be a salad. When checking in I asked for the meal and was told hat nothing had been ordered. I should the email and all I got was a shrug. Luckily it was only a short flight. Poor service and attitude.
reviews.author: Paul S

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: I was about to book a flight and since there is no direct flight from Tokyo to Berlin, I enquired by phone to ask my total luggage allowance. The website does not explain the procedure on long connecting flights. I wanted to make sure that I do not have to collect my checked-in luggage in Mongolia where I have a long layover(11 hours). Their customer service call centre in Mongolia did not speak fluent English. I am not being hypercritical, but the level of their training is far too awful. I feel like I was talking to someone who just started to learn English - considering the fact that it is supposed to receive international calls. I was promised an answer by email but I never got any single "hello" from them. I also tried to ring their Japanese office to seek answers, poor Japanese language skills. It was their Tokyo branch! I was promised a callback as the operator was not sure if I can possibly not collect my luggage on my layover - it is too much of a hassle if I have to carry two 23kg bags with me to the hotel and check them in again! Most airlines do take care of your luggage once you check them in and you do not need to collect them during a layover. I again did not receive any single call from them. When you promise to email or call your customer, you have to! I am booking a flight with other airlines with better customer service. There is a reason their flights are cheap - cheap service. Unbelievable.
reviews.author: 雄人 蔺

reviews.title: MIAT Mongolian Air Line
reviews.text: I always check the Air line IATA safety ,Safety rating if 7/7 . then I would be happy to fly on the air craft. Small Air lines but safety rating records are good. Personally I am not unhappy if there is a flight delay due to technical reasons. Not very concerned over the type of food etc.We all want to fly safely to our destinations. I travelled in July 2017,but I was compelled to select july 2018 in the System for this review
reviews.author: nmimbulgoda

reviews.title: Crowded and Uncomfortable
reviews.text: The MIAT staff try very hard but the airline has old planes which have terrible seats, little legroom, small lockers. The Cabin Staff are always charming and helpful. I will fault that they allow people to board with far too much hand luggae. Its always a battle to get any space in overhead bins usually you dont. The boarding is always chaos because everyone is climbing over each other to try to find space for the large amounts of cabin baggage they haul. Its strange because on check in they will nail you if you are 1 KG over in bag weight but they say and do nothing for all the people who carry excessive hand luggage and packages. In flight entertainment is non existent and even the Airline Magazine has no English version. Catering is basic but OK. MIAT are not bad but desperately need new modern aircraft with the facility people expect now. If they just enforced cabin baggage policy they would stop the chaos trying to embark and disembark and make things much more comfortable.
reviews.author: rcameron2018

reviews.title: Functional but maybe late
reviews.text: Not many flights out of Ulaanbaatar so there is not much choice. I choose Mongolia Airlines because they have the experience of flying in extreme weathers. Functional
reviews.author: Bob M

reviews.title: Very impressed
reviews.text: I flew Mongolian airlines not really knowing much about them and came Home impressed,I thought the service was outstanding nothing was a problem.I picked row 4 just behind the business class as I was told the seats are close together but in my row I had plenty of space more leg room.Both my flights were on time I would most definitely recommend this airline thumbs up.
reviews.author: michaelhT8010MC

reviews.title: Better than most legacy airlines
reviews.text: I enjoyed my flights with MIAT more than any flight with a bigger airline. For starters, the seat size and legroom were very generous - while other airlines seem keen to trade passenger comfort for more seats, MIAT’s happy to remain generous with their space. Also, both of my flights were virtually empty and there was an empty middle seat in my row. In addition to besting bigger airlines, MIAT’s also better than most other budget airlines I’ve flown. Meals are included, as is a checked bag on international flights. Overall, if you’re headed to Mongolia, I think MIAT is your best choice to fly.
reviews.author: turtlesarecool

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: Round trip Beijing - Ulan Bataar. Non-descript average airline in terms of service and friendliness. Return flight was delayed 3 hours but there may have been good reason. We didn't understand the announcements. Chinggis Khan International Airport is small and dated with limited food options so it was not an ideal place to hang out for three hours.
reviews.author: carlc256

reviews.title: Delay handled relatively well
reviews.text: My daughter and I had booked a long trip from New Delhi to Ulaanbaatar, via Hong Kong, an a 12 hour layover became a 24 hour layover. While the first leg of the flight till HK is a code share flight and operated by Cathay Pacific, the second leg was operated by MIAT. Although the airlines handled it relatively well and took good care of us, the lack of information was both puzzling and disturbing. We never got to know what caused the inordinate delay. However, we were happy that the baggage that was parked at HK airport for 24 hours came through safely. Food is decent but nowhere near the quality offered by other major airlines. There is no personal on-board entertainment. The aircraft are well-maintained and the pilots are always competent. We have no real issues on this route other than cost of their flights. MIAT is the state-owned airline and has a kind of monopoly among airlines operating in/via Mongolia. Airlines that offer cheaper tickets are not allowed to operate in Mongolia, so air fares of flights into and out of Mongolia are considerably expensive.
reviews.author: transkript

reviews.title: A good experience but crowded seats
reviews.text: Mongolian Airlines (MIAT) often gets somewhat of a bad reputation. It's true that it is a low budget carrier, that means you don't have a lot of extras on the flight, but I found it friendly, well organised, and good value. This seating was a little bit uncomfortable because there was very little space, but the food was good. People at check-in and also inside the plane were friendly and professional.
reviews.author: bluehorizons2015

reviews.title: MIAt
reviews.text: Stuff's are very helpful and kind food quality is quite high. One of my favorite airline. Pilots are very experienced. Always feel safe.Thankyou so much Miat.
reviews.author: Naraa N

reviews.title: Good flight
reviews.text: The plane was a 737-800, in good condition. Seats were comfortable. Staff were very friendly and polite. They served a good meal. Before landing they served a pizza that was very good. Baggage upon arrival arrived fast. I would highly recommend the airline.
reviews.author: wolf3728

reviews.title: No english speaker in UB airport. Flight delay no explanation
reviews.text: Arrived 3 hours earlier ( 6 am) to the airport to find out the flight was delay ( from screen infos) . As i had to be in Berlin that same day, i asked for more infos. The only thing all agents presents could say is " wait". No english speaker from that company. we waited 5 hours without any explanation besides. "seat here and wait" they even fake searching for infos but as they didn't understand a word neither . Result. lost my connection in Berlin. rebooked an extra flight plus night hotel in Berlin. Wrote to the company. Result. SILENCE! BAYARLALAA
reviews.author: Marion C

reviews.title: Fly with MIAT
reviews.text: My friend’s luggage was not arriving with her. Her luggage arrived in the next day. When we told this happened to our guide in UB she said it’s normal, often happens. Not only her baggege left in Beijing but some passengers as well. In general, flight are fun and on time.
reviews.author: ErykahBlack

reviews.title: pleasant flight
reviews.text: Cathay Dragon was on this flight, but this was MIAT's flight. Did not advance online check in but still got decent seats. Standard seats ok, no screen just like low cost carriers. Food was ok for a under 4hrs flight.
reviews.author: SamuraiGun

reviews.title: Most horrible experience with customer service and MIAT Airlines Manager
reviews.text: I had a bad experience and I didn't even fly MIAT airlines. I missed my flight to Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia from Beijing at 1:40am in the morning, as I arrived and there were no staff from MIAT airlines to a) help with check-in, or b) direct me to get onto the next flight or get reimbursed for the flight. Not one person was there. I went to the attending airport customer service to ask for help and they called MIAT airlines 3 times (2 times before flight and one time after), to which on the third time, they called, MIAT airlines picked up talked with the attendee and when attendee asked them if they could talk to me, they refused, while I was standing there listening in. Beyond being enraged at not getting to talk to MIAT personnel at all, I later was able to get in contact with the Manager of MIAT Airlines in Beijing, to which he threatened to sue me if I wrote a bad review. That is quite ridiculous. I had only asked MIAT Airlines to send a written documentation to the third party Feixu platform on Alipay that I had bought the ticket on to help me get reimbursement of 500rmb for the ticket, a ticket I bought for 2700rmb and they refused. In this case, as they are the airline, I don't believe they lose any money. It would be just be providing documentation to get the third party to reimburse me the 500rmb. I complained to them about their service personnel being intentionally unavailable to talk post missing the flight and instead of helping to resolve the situation, and when I said that I will be posting on TripAdvisor to warn other people, the Manager threatened they, MIAT Airlines, could come and sue me. True story. Never fly MIAT Airlines if you have to. Poor service on top of added injury to passengers. I definitely don't recommend this airline or their staff. I am appalled at the way I was treated by a Manager.
reviews.author: fierybluelotus

reviews.title: MIAT airlines flight from Hongkong to Ulanbaataar
reviews.text: Nice clean aircraft, good service. The food was good too with an option of chicken or beef for non vegetarians
reviews.author: Harish Suvarna

reviews.title: Average flught
reviews.text: A very short flight of just over 2 hours. Cold snack served, totally forgettable, no entertainment, nothing in English
reviews.author: Patsy K

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Another great flight with MIAT Mongolian Airlines. Check-In, staffs and stewardess are kindly.If you not sure about this airline. No doubt it's best Mongolian airline.
reviews.author: Sambuu-Yondon
